Won from beating Winter 2019|Former Inventory Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Earned by beating the Xmas 2019 event|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Blaster''' is a tower that pierces through and freezes any enemy hit by its projectile. It could have been unlocked by triumphing [[Village of Despair]] during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It could have also been through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|350}}. It was most recently available again for {{Robux|525}}. The '''Frost Blaster''' starts out with decent damage, gaining more damage at higher levels and it also has a somewhat high firerate. However, it fires piercing projectiles that freezes enemies when hit. Any enemy with the [[Freeze Immunity]] cannot be slowed down, frozen or have its [[Defense]] dropped by the '''Frost Blaster'''. This makes '''Frost Blaster''' an offensive support hybrid since it has a higher DPS than the [[Freezer]]. Starting at Level 2, the '''Frost Blaster''' will melt 15% defense every tick, though it can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. The '''Frost Blaster''' is mostly considered as an early to midgame tower, though it can sometimes be considered as an all-around tower. Its relatively low-medium placement cost and decent DPS can be useful in the early game, while its later upgrades and relatively higher DPS can be sufficient in the mid to late game. Though, this tower should mainly be used as a staller and crowd control tower due to its freezing and piercing capabilities. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Frost Blaster's''' piercing projectile makes it a great tower for early and mid-game. **For earlier waves, a Level 0-2 '''Frost Blaster''' can be effective at killing enemies that spawn, though by the time high health singular enemies spawn, like the [[Elite Abnormal]], it should be upgraded to Level 3 because of its higher DPS and better chilling **Later on in the game the '''Frost Blaster''' does not have enough DPS to deal with enemies like the [[Fallen Giant]] or [[Hidden Boss]] on its own, meaning that you need other towers alongside it. ***It can, however, be useful at chilling enemies and decreasing their [[Defense]]. *Unlike other freezing towers, the '''Frost Blaster''' only chills an enemy. **Larger enemies, like the [[Fallen Giant]] will get slowed down for a shorter amount of time. Additionally, it cannot slow down any enemy that has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. **It can still apply the chillness slowdown effect to [[Boss]] enemies, as long as it does not have [[Freeze Immunity]]. However, the slowdown effect will be much weaker. **The Level 3 is especially good at slowing down, as its freeze time and firerate are nearly identical, allowing to close to permanently slow down smaller enemies. *The '''Frost Blaster's''' [[Defense]] melting ability can be useful for decreasing an enemy's [[Defense]], allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **However, do note that as the defense melting happens when an enemy is slowed down. Because of this, freeze immune enemies cannot have their defense melted. **The defense melt can stack with other towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]], allowing you to remove an enemy's defense entirely. ***However, the '''Frost Blaster's''' defense melt does not stack with other freezing towers. *The '''Frost Blaster's''' range is quite high at Level 4, making it harder for enemies to get out of its range. **This also means it is able to chills enemies from far ranges, surpassing many other stalling towers in this regard. **You can use the [[DJ Booth]] to increase this already high range even more. *Because of the '''Frost Blaster's''' freezing and cheap hidden detection, it can be used against early hidden enemies like the [[Fallen Soul]] or [[Hidden]]. **However, it may be best to upgrade a single one to Level 2-3 or place multiple Level 1 '''Frost Blasters''' as a single Level 1 '''Frost Blaster''' is unlikely to deal with them on their own, especially against [[Fallen Soul]]s. **Later on, Level 4 '''Frost Blasters''' are effective at freezing high health hidden enemies like the [[Hidden Boss]], [[Elite Phantom]] and [[Elite Soul]]. *The '''Frost Blaster''' is effective against [[Lead]]s and [[Elite Lead]]s as it has lead detection from Level 0 and can freeze them. **The '''Frost Blaster''' should be upgraded to Level 2-3 or have multiple lower levels placed down because of their high health. ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Blaster''' is the oldest tower in the game that has yet to receive a skin. **The [[Soldier]]
